gloss: how many minutes; what minute (past the hour)

definitions.explanation: Asks the length of a span of time in minutes. Usually appears with かかる, かかりますか, or 〜くらい.

definitions.gloss: what minute (clock reading past the hour)
definitions.explanation: Asks the minute portion of a clock time, normally in the pattern {何時|なんじ}{何分|なんぷん}.

examples.japanese: {何分|なんぷん}⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many minutes does it take?

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{何分|なんぷん}くらいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: About how many minutes is it to the station?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、あと{何分|なんぷん}⟦{残|のこ}っています→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many minutes are left until the meeting starts?

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧{何分|なんぷん}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is it now, to the minute?

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧{何分|なんぷん}でした⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What was the departure time — nine what?

examples.japanese: ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧{何分|なんぷん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I can't see the clock, so please tell me exactly what time it is.

notes:
The interrogative ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ plus the counter 〜⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧ (minutes), which becomes ぷん after ん.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何分|なんぷん}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to take how many minutes
- ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧{何分|なんぷん}: what time exactly (hour and minute)
- {何分|なんぷん}{間|かん}: for how many minutes (duration, explicitly marked)
- あと{何分|なんぷん}: how many minutes remain

PRONUNCIATION:
The counter alternates between ふん and ぷん depending on the number: ⟦{一分|いっぷん}→一分：30314_ippun⟧, {二分|にふん}, {三分|さんぷん}, {四分|よんぷん}, ⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧. The interrogative always takes ぷん.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何分|なにぶん}: same kanji, different reading and meaning — "anyway, given the circumstances"
